findings.text: follow-on: the M4 lost count mixes two referents in one column, because at the 600 s row any actual review whose fingerprint the replay did not re-review contributes (the calibration gap, 123 findings) while at 1800 s and 3600 s a finding is counted only when the 600 s replay read it and this window did not (a marginal loss, 97 and 117), so the section 5 table's lost column is not comparable across the M4 rows and reads as if a longer settle window loses fewer findings than the 600 s baseline.
